fact.content: A single real Engineer dispatch (run-20260929-percentage-001, agent_id ad83b17a223d91a03) produced two independent transport-contract violations within one Implementation phase: its first pre_test_requested reply was wrapped in a Markdown code fence (corrected via the one permitted transport repair), and its very next post_test_requested reply -- from the same agent, same turn sequence -- carried leading prose plus another Markdown fence. The underlying implementation edit itself (demo-repo/src/loanflow/primitives.py's Percentage.__post_init__ type check) was correct and minimal on inspection, but the phase still blocked because the one-correction-per-phase transport-repair budget was already spent on the first turn.
